g.text: Zigzag tip-spacing tests — 10 layers per pair
Left-to-right order: 0.3 to 1.0 mm tip spacing; each size at 0% then 50% part cooling.
Every layer 1: 1 mm/s, fan OFF. Layers 2–10: 15 mm/s at the labeled fan setting.
Top view; front of build plate at bottom. Each specimen finishes before the next begins.
Under each pair: specimen number, triangle-tip spacing, then layers 2–10 fan percentage.
Pair centers: X23, X37, …, X233 mm, Y126. Minimum clear gap: 5.75 mm.
Uniform scaling applies to the zigzag pair. Straight intro and outro lines remain 10 mm each.
0.15 mm line width · 0.06 mm layer height · 0.60 mm total height · 245°C nozzle · 85°C bed.
Purge: 20 mm/s. Auxiliary fan OFF. 50% part fan uses PWM 128/255. Labels are not printed.
Diagram shows nozzle centerlines. Static checks passed; no physical printer test performed.
